prompt: The share window says anyone with the link. The client needs the drawings tonight.

choices.label: Add their work addresses, then send.
Send it to a personal mailbox.

prompt: You sent a link with no names on it. Someone forwards it.

choices.label: Only the first person can open it.
Anyone who receives it can open it.
It expires when you close the laptop.

prompt: A meeting that is not about customers wants the full list in a slide. The sheet says internal.

choices.label: Ask the owner what they may see.
Paste the count, not the names.

prompt: You are not sure the slide is allowed to hold those names.

choices.label: An internal meeting makes it fine.
The mark on the sheet is the rule. Ask.
Drop the header and paste the rows.

prompt: A personal writing tool will clean up a complaint. The account number is in the paragraph.

choices.label: Paste it. The tool is only for writing.
Take the name out, then paste the rest.

prompt: That writing tool is signed in with your personal account.

choices.label: Personal is fine if you delete it after.
A customer complaint does not belong there.
It is safe if the tool says private.
